download_risebench_data: download the RISEBench dataset from HuggingFace to a specified data directory
download_risebench_force: force re-download the RISEBench dataset even if data already exists locally
load_risebench_prompts: load RISEBench prompts from the downloaded JSON data into a dictionary
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how RISEBench data is fetched from HuggingFace
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function to understand how RISEBench prompts are parsed and structured
